Japan's CoCo Ichibanya Curry Chain May Be Sold

House Foods Group, the parent company of Japan's largest curry chain, CoCo Ichibanya, is considering selling the business. The confirmation came after shares of the operator, Ichibanya, surged 16% on the news. The potential sale was reported by international wire services.
